name: Fast Corp Ltd
description: All-in-one Bulgarian EU company launch + ongoing compliance. Online EOOD/OOD formation in ~3–5 business days (formation from ~€1,500–€1,750), then optional bookkeeping/VAT/payroll (accounting from ~€229/mo). EU IBAN/banking support, virtual office, 10% corporate tax pitch. Bootstrapped, Sofia, team 2–5, ~3,000 clients claimed since 2018.

mentions.evidence: ~$8.6k L30, ~$56k all-time, MRR not listed as seat subscriptions (formation + service mix). Founded Jul 2025 on TrustMRR profile (ops claim longer history), Bulgaria. Last sync Oct 2, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Pick one low-tax / high-bureaucracy EU (or LatAm) jurisdiction and sell remote incorporation + bookkeeping as a productized firm. Switching costs explode once VAT and payroll live there.

whyItPrints: Same shape as LegalOne (FR legal notices) and Khosmos (FR trade invoicing): own one country's mandatory admin stack. Formation is a high-ticket front door; monthly accounting is the sticky recurring layer. Entrepreneurs pay to avoid lawyers and tax chaos.
